name: omaania
author: rob-d3v
description: Ania Player for Omarchy: a talking desktop avatar and voice assistant that answers with your Omarchy agent. One-click setup from the bar. Unofficial community plugin.

barWidget.description: Ania Player avatar state. Click shows or hides the avatar; right click opens the menu: lock position, change avatar, marketplace, credits, briefing, biometric unlock, settings and logs.
